kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: T2 is 2a inline on every block (conventions 24): the lock leads the value inside the well, the label stays color.text.secondary, the reason sits under the field (CMP-040's line).

kids.name: value-2
kids.chars: Copy gaps drawn as 6 px stub bars in the slot's ink: the placeholders, CMP-034's revealed value, CMP-065's description and field labels (the spec gives no string; never invented).

kids.name: value-3
kids.chars: Glyphs: search ⌕, danger ⊘, minus −, plus +, eye ○ / eye-off ●, copy ⧉, check ✓, chevron-right ▸ / chevron-down ▾, close ✕ are text glyphs; the lock is the local icon.

kids.name: value-4
kids.chars: Bare invalid wells (CMP-007, CMP-008) draw only the 2 px boundary: the danger glyph + words live in the host's CMP-040 message line (conventions 23), drawn on CMP-040 invalid.

kids.name: value-5
kids.chars: Field width 168 px (stepper and section fields 96 px): an author choice; the spec sizes fields by their host.
